title: KBD stage handoff
description: Written to .kbd-orchestrator/phases/<node>/handoffs/<stage>.handoff.json when a lifecycle stage completes (or is explicitly skipped). The next stage's gate (shared/lib/stage-gate.sh kbd_stage_gate) requires the previous stage's handoff to exist. Stage order: assess → analyze → spec → plan → execute → reflect; analyze and spec are optional stages the gate walks back across when absent.

outputs.description: Artifact paths this stage produced (phase-dir-relative or repo-relative).

nextStage.description: The following stage in canonical order; null after reflect.

summaryForNext.description: One-to-three sentences the next stage reads first: what was produced, what is open, what to do with it.

skipped.description: True when the stage was deliberately skipped; the gate passes but the skip is on record.

skipReason.description: Required human reason when skipped is true.

identity.description: OPTIONAL for assess/analyze/spec handoffs, REQUIRED by the Plan→Execute boundary (enforced by shared/lib/stage-gate.sh). Binds the handoff to canonical identity and the adopted contract so stale or foreign handoffs are rejected instead of silently accepted.

runId.description: Canonical run id from prometheus kbd status.

phaseId.description: Canonical phase id; must equal the phase directory the handoff lives in.

planRevision.description: Plan revision the handoff was produced against.

contractDigest.description: SHA-256 of the adopted contract under the contract's digestNormalization (identity.contractDigest and identity.planRevision excluded).
